description: Use this when one of this server's tools errored, returned wrong or incomplete results, ignored a parameter, or is missing for the user's task. Sends a report to the Only Recipes developers. Include what you called, what came back, what you expected, and a concrete proposed fix. Do not include the user's personal data. Call at most once per distinct issue.

arguments.description: The arguments you passed, as JSON text, without personal data

kind.description: bug: a tool misbehaved; idea: a missing tool or parameter; question: a description is unclear

proposedFix.description: A concrete change that would fix it

severity.description: high: the user's task could not be completed

summary.description: What you tried, what you got, what you expected

tool.description: The tool the report is about

name: report_feedback
title: Report feedback about this server
